name: InterContinental Jakarta Pondok Indah
positioning: City hotel in South Jakarta's Pondok Indah district, connected to the Pondok Indah Malls, with a garden pool and Inaria Spa
best_for: Travelers who want shopping and dining right at the door in South Jakarta
Golfers who want to be within walking distance of Pondok Indah Golf Course

facts.text: The hotel sits in South Jakarta's shopping and business district, as part of an entertainment complex with the Pondok Indah shopping malls and golf course.
Inaria Spa has hydrotherapy, a sauna and steam bathing.
Inaria Spa treatments include facials, body scrubs and foot reflexology.
The pool area has a dedicated event space for evening gatherings under the stars.
Rooms have a 55-inch TV that connects with your phone or laptop.
Suites include the Ambassador Suite and the Presidential Suite.
Shio is a Japanese teppanyaki restaurant serving seasonal dishes and omakase menus.
Pondok Indah Water Park is about 0.1 kilometers from the hotel.
Lebak Bulus MRT Station is about 10 minutes from the hotel.
The hotel is a single-use plastic free hotel, and kids eat free.
Self parking is complimentary for hotel guests.

highlights.text: The hotel is seamlessly connected to the Pondok Indah Malls, with shopping, dining and entertainment a swing door away.
The outdoor pool is set amid an intricately designed, lush garden with views over Pondok Indah.
Pondok Indah Golf Course, designed by golf architect Robert Trent Jones Jr., is within walking distance.
Rooms have a spacious bathroom with a rain shower and a deep bathtub.
Sugar & Spice blends cuisines of five continents across six show kitchens, including a private teppanyaki restaurant.

considerations.text: Soekarno-Hatta International Airport is about 35 kilometers from the hotel.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the distance from Jakarta's city center may require transportation planning.
